caption:
Two funded traders close the same trade for the same profit. One books it and moves on — the other doubles his size on the next one.

Nothing about his method changed between those two trades — only how he felt about it did. Excitement and edge produce the exact same rush, and only one of them survives a losing streak.

A single win doesn't validate a system, it just makes the next mistake feel earned.
